mapper.select: -- 순수 범위 조회는 잠금/네트워크가 없다. 예약 시만 source 이후 게시 정책을 잠근다. SELECT p.id AS policy_id,p.policy_status_code,p.mode_code,p.rule_release_id,r.release_status_code,p.policy_hash, p.settings_json::text AS settings_json,p.profile_manifest_json::text AS profile_manifest_json,p.row_version FROM announcement_attachment_policies p JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_releases r ON r.id=p.rule_release_id WHERE p.id=#{policyId} FOR SHARE OF p,r
mapper.sql: s.semantic_status_code<>'EXCLUDED' AND e.id IS NOT NULL AND e.decision_status_code<>'EXCLUDED' AND e.title_stage_code IN ('GROUP_A_MATCHED','COMBINATION_MATCHED') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_links l WHERE l.source_id=s.id)
mapper.select: -- 서로 배타적인 전체 범위 집계. QA/삭제 원문을 역조회하지 않으며 보호 제외도 숨기지 않는다. SELECT provider_code,reason_code,count(1) AS item_count FROM ( SELECT s.provider_code,CASE WHEN s.semantic_status_code='EXCLUDED' OR e.id IS NULL OR e.decision_status_code='EXCLUDED' OR e.title_stage_code IS NULL OR e.title_stage_code NOT IN ('GROUP_A_MATCHED','COMBINATION_MATCHED') THEN 'TITLE_OR_BASE_NOT_ELIGIBLE' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_links l WHERE l.source_id=s.id) THEN 'LINKED_PROTECTED' ELSE 'CANDIDATE' END AS reason_code FROM announcement_source_snapshots s LEFT JOIN announcement_source_classification_evaluations e ON e.source_id=s.id AND e.is_current WHERE ) scoped GROUP BY provider_code,reason_code ORDER BY provider_code,reason_code

-- 최대 건수는 명시된 부분 범위다. 준비 실패/규칙 불일치를 자동 제외하여 다음 원문으로 채우지 않는다. SELECT s.id AS source_id,s.provider_code,e.content_version_id,e.id AS base_evaluation_id,e.rule_release_id, s.classification_row_version AS source_version,s.attachment_row_version AS attachment_version, s.current_attachment_evaluation_id AS current_evaluation_id,s.attachment_policy_id AS current_policy_id, c.id AS confirmation_id,s.is_attachment_review_required AS review_required, (SELECT j.id FROM announcement_attachment_jobs j WHERE j.source_id=s.id AND j.job_status_code IN ('SCOPE_READY','PENDING','RUNNING','RETRY_WAIT','PAUSED')) AS active_job_id FROM announcement_source_snapshots s JOIN announcement_source_classification_evaluations e ON e.source_id=s.id AND e.is_current LEFT JOIN announcement_source_attachment_confirmations c ON c.source_id=s.id AND c.is_current WHERE AND ORDER BY s.collected_at,s.id LIMIT #{maximumCount}
-- source부터 UUID 순서로 잠근 뒤 정책/batch/job을 처리한다. SELECT id FROM announcement_source_snapshots WHERE id IN #{source} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

-- 전체 관리 기록에서 정해진 ID만 확인한다. 원래 필터/LIMIT를 반복하거나 준비 실패분을 채우지 않는다. SELECT s.id AS source_id,s.provider_code,e.content_version_id,e.id AS base_evaluation_id,e.rule_release_id, s.classification_row_version AS source_version,s.attachment_row_version AS attachment_version, s.current_attachment_evaluation_id AS current_evaluation_id,s.attachment_policy_id AS current_policy_id, c.id AS confirmation_id,s.is_attachment_review_required AS review_required, (SELECT j.id FROM announcement_attachment_jobs j WHERE j.source_id=s.id AND j.job_status_code IN ('SCOPE_READY','PENDING','RUNNING','RETRY_WAIT','PAUSED')) AS active_job_id FROM announcement_source_snapshots s JOIN announcement_source_classification_evaluations e ON e.source_id=s.id AND e.is_current LEFT JOIN announcement_source_attachment_confirmations c ON c.source_id=s.id AND c.is_current WHERE s.id IN #{source} AND s.data_purpose_code='PRODUCTION' AND ORDER BY s.id
-- 동일 actor/입력의 배치 생성은 한 번만 기록한다. SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(CAST(#{key} AS text),73105))::text
mapper.sql: id AS batch_id,policy_id,batch_status_code,scope_hash,maximum_count,scope_item_count,deleted_item_count, row_version,scope_json::text AS scope_json,policy_snapshot_json::text AS policy_snapshot_json,requested_by,idempotency_key,request_hash,created_at
mapper.select: -- 조건이 바뀌어도 같은 멱등 키의 최초 배치를 반환한다. SELECT FROM announcement_attachment_batches WHERE idempotency_key=#{key}
-- 관리 배치만 조회한다. 상태 변경에서만 행 잠금을 사용한다. SELECT FROM announcement_attachment_batches WHERE id=#{batchId} AND scope_item_count IS NOT NULL FOR UPDATE
-- 범위가 고정된 관리 배치 수. SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_attachment_batches WHERE scope_item_count IS NOT NULL

-- 고정된 jobs만 페이지 조회하며 필터를 재실행하지 않는다. 원문 제목/주소는 포함하지 않는다. SELECT id AS job_id,source_id,frozen_provider_code AS provider_code,job_status_code, expected_source_version AS source_version,expected_attachment_version AS attachment_version, error_code,application_status_code,rollback_status_code FROM announcement_attachment_jobs WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY source_id,id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

-- 캐시 성공 건수 대신 실제 전체 job 상태를 집계한다. 삭제 건수는 batch 별도 metadata다. SELECT frozen_provider_code AS provider_code,job_status_code AS reason_code,count(1) AS item_count FROM announcement_attachment_jobs WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} GROUP BY frozen_provider_code,job_status_code ORDER BY frozen_provider_code,job_status_code
mapper.insert: -- 범위 확정은 외부 수집/적용 승인이 아니다. INSERT INTO announcement_attachment_batches(id,batch_type_code,policy_id,batch_status_code,scope_json,scope_hash,maximum_count, requested_by,reason_hash,idempotency_key,request_hash,scope_item_count,policy_snapshot_json) VALUES (#{batchId},'BACKFILL',#{policyId},'SCOPE_READY',CAST(#{scopeJson} AS jsonb),#{scopeHash},#{maximumCount}, #{requestedBy},#{reasonHash},#{idempotencyKey},#{requestHash},#{itemCount},CAST(#{policySnapshotJson} AS jsonb))

-- SCOPE_READY는 worker claim 대상이 아니다. source pointer/version/확인은 바꾸지 않는다. INSERT INTO announcement_attachment_jobs(id,source_id,content_version_id,base_evaluation_id,rule_release_id,policy_id,batch_id, generation,expected_source_version,expected_attachment_version,job_status_code,idempotency_key,request_hash, execution_snapshot_json,download_budget_bytes,previous_attachment_evaluation_id,previous_confirmation_id, previous_policy_id,previous_is_review_required,operation_code,requested_by,frozen_provider_code,frozen_locator_hash) VALUES (#{job.jobId},#{job.sourceId},#{job.contentVersionId},#{job.baseEvaluationId},#{job.ruleReleaseId},#{job.policyId},#{batchId}, #{job.generation},#{job.expectedSourceVersion},#{job.expectedAttachmentVersion},'SCOPE_READY',#{job.idempotencyKey},#{job.requestHash}, CAST(#{job.executionSnapshotJson} AS jsonb),#{job.downloadBudgetBytes},#{job.previousEvaluationId},#{job.previousConfirmationId}, #{job.previousPolicyId},#{job.previousReviewRequired},'COLLECT',#{job.requestedBy},#{providerCode},attachment_source_locator_hash(#{job.sourceId}))
mapper.update: -- 수집 시작 전 취소만 허용한다. 실행 중 중지/원복과 구분한다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_batches SET batch_status_code='CANCELLED',row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{batchId} AND row_version=#{expectedVersion} AND batch_status_code='SCOPE_READY'

-- 예약 취소는 삭제가 아니다. active job 제약을 해제하면서 고정 이력을 유지한다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_jobs SET job_status_code='CANCELLED',error_code='SCOPE_CANCELLED',row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND job_status_code='SCOPE_READY'
mapper.select: -- 출처는 지문만 비교하고 API에 반환하지 않는다. 고정 jobs 외 대상을 추가하지 않는다. SELECT id AS job_id,source_id,frozen_provider_code AS provider_code,job_status_code,request_hash, execution_snapshot_json::text AS execution_snapshot_json,download_budget_bytes, frozen_locator_hash=attachment_source_locator_hash(source_id) AND attachment_backfill_batch_input_unchanged(id) AS locator_unchanged FROM announcement_attachment_jobs WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY source_id,id

-- 최초 필터를 재실행하지 않고 고정 source의 최신 보호/확인/판정만 대조한다. 자신의 예약은 충돌이 아니다. SELECT s.id AS source_id,s.provider_code,e.content_version_id,e.id AS base_evaluation_id,e.rule_release_id, s.classification_row_version AS source_version,s.attachment_row_version AS attachment_version, s.current_attachment_evaluation_id AS current_evaluation_id,s.attachment_policy_id AS current_policy_id, c.id AS confirmation_id,s.is_attachment_review_required AS review_required, (SELECT other.id FROM announcement_attachment_jobs other WHERE other.source_id=s.id AND other.id<>j.id AND other.job_status_code IN ('SCOPE_READY','PENDING','RUNNING','RETRY_WAIT','PAUSED')) AS active_job_id FROM announcement_attachment_jobs j JOIN announcement_source_snapshots s ON s.id=j.source_id JOIN announcement_source_classification_evaluations e ON e.source_id=s.id AND e.is_current LEFT JOIN announcement_source_attachment_confirmations c ON c.source_id=s.id AND c.is_current WHERE j.batch_id=#{batchId} AND s.data_purpose_code='PRODUCTION' AND ORDER BY s.id
mapper.update: -- ADMIN이 고정 범위와 상한을 확인한 최초 실행만 기록한다. 현재 판정/정책 binding은 바꾸지 않는다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_batches SET batch_status_code='COLLECTION_PENDING',approved_by=#{actorId}, collection_started_at=clock_timestamp(),collection_approval_hash=#{approvalHash},row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{batchId} AND row_version=#{expectedVersion} AND batch_status_code='SCOPE_READY' AND deleted_item_count=0

-- 고정 예약만 worker에 공개한다. 새 job/시도/예산/원문 version을 만들지 않는다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_jobs SET job_status_code='PENDING',next_attempt_at=clock_timestamp(),row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND job_status_code='SCOPE_READY'

-- 이미 전송 중인 요청은 정리될 수 있다. 새 claim/HTTP는 batch gate로 차단하며 job 예산과 checkpoint를 유지한다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_batches SET batch_status_code='COLLECTION_PAUSED',row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{batchId} AND row_version=#{expectedVersion} AND batch_status_code IN ('COLLECTION_PENDING','COLLECTING')

-- 최초 승인과 고정 범위는 보존한다. 완료/실패한 항목을 재시도하거나 예산을 환급하지 않는다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_batches SET batch_status_code='COLLECTING',row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{batchId} AND row_version=#{expectedVersion} AND batch_status_code='COLLECTION_PAUSED'

-- 실제 전체 jobs와 삭제 건수로 집계한다. 중지 상태는 자동 해제하지 않고 적용/분류 preview 상태로 넘기지 않는다. WITH locked AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT b.id,b.batch_status_code,b.scope_item_count,b.deleted_item_count FROM announcement_attachment_batches b WHERE b.scope_item_count IS NOT NULL AND b.batch_status_code IN ('COLLECTION_PENDING','COLLECTING') AND ((b.batch_status_code='COLLECTION_PENDING' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_attachment_jobs j WHERE j.batch_id=b.id AND j.attempt_count>0)) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_attachment_jobs j WHERE j.batch_id=b.id AND j.job_status_code NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','PARTIAL_FAILED','FAILED','CONFLICT','CANCELLED'))) ORDER BY b.updated_at,b.id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 100 ), counts AS ( SELECT b.id,b.batch_status_code,b.scope_item_count,b.deleted_item_count,count(j.id) AS remaining, count(j.id) FILTER (WHERE j.job_status_code IN ('SUCCEEDED','PARTIAL_FAILED','FAILED','CONFLICT','CANCELLED')) AS terminal, count(j.id) FILTER (WHERE j.job_status_code='SUCCEEDED' AND j.preview_evaluation_id IS NOT NULL AND j.preview_hash IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_attachment_sets sealed WHERE sealed.id=j.set_id AND sealed.set_status_code='SEALED')) AS succeeded, count(j.id) FILTER (WHERE j.attempt_count>0) AS attempted FROM locked b LEFT JOIN announcement_attachment_jobs j ON j.batch_id=b.id GROUP BY b.id,b.batch_status_code,b.scope_item_count,b.deleted_item_count ), progress AS ( SELECT id,CASE WHEN terminal=remaining THEN CASE WHEN succeeded=scope_item_count AND deleted_item_count=0 THEN 'COLLECTED' ELSE 'COLLECTION_PARTIAL_FAILED' END WHEN attempted>0 THEN 'COLLECTING' ELSE batch_status_code END AS next_status FROM counts WHERE remaining+deleted_item_count=scope_item_count ) UPDATE announcement_attachment_batches b SET batch_status_code=p.next_status,row_version=b.row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() FROM progress p WHERE b.id=p.id AND b.batch_status_code<>p.next_status
